GetNumberOfConsoleInputEvents@WIN32API.I.desc: Retrieves the number of unread input records in the console input buffer. Returns nonzero on success.

GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a console screen buffer (size, cursor position, text attributes, window rectangle) into a CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO structure.

GetLargestConsoleWindowSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the size (COORD, in character cells) of the largest possible console window, based on the current font and display size.

GetConsoleCursorInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the size and visibility of the cursor for a console screen buffer into a CONSOLE_CURSOR_INFO structure.

GetNumberOfConsoleMouseButtons@WIN32API..desc: Retrieves the number of buttons on the mouse used by the current console. Returns nonzero on success.

SetConsoleMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the input mode of a console input buffer or the output mode of a console screen buffer (flags such as ENABLE_ECHO_INPUT, ENABLE_PROCESSED_OUTPUT).

SetConsoleActiveScreenBuffer@WIN32API.IN.desc: Makes the specified screen buffer the currently displayed console screen buffer.

FlushConsoleInputBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Discards all input records currently in the console input buffer.

SetConsoleScreenBufferSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the size (in character rows and columns) of the specified console screen buffer.

SetConsoleCursorPosition@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the cursor position (COORD) in the specified console screen buffer.

SetConsoleCursorInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the size and visibility of the cursor for the specified console screen buffer.

ScrollConsoleScreenBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves a block of data in a console screen buffer, optionally clipped, and fills the vacated cells with a given character and attribute.

SetConsoleWindowInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the current size and position of a console screen buffer's window, in absolute or relative coordinates.

SetConsoleTextAttribute@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the foreground and background color attributes of characters written to the console screen buffer.

SetConsoleCtrlHandler@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds or removes an application-defined handler routine for console control events such as Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Break and close.

GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a Ctrl+C or Ctrl+Break signal to a console process group that shares the console of the calling process.

AllocConsole@WIN32API.INC.desc: Allocates a new console for the calling process. Fails if the process already has a console.

FreeConsole@WIN32API.INC.desc: Detaches the calling process from its console.

GetConsoleTitle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the title of the current console window into a buffer. Returns the length of the title in characters, or 0 on failure.

ReadConsole@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads character input from the console input buffer and removes it from the buffer. Returns nonzero on success; the number of characters read is returned in a parameter.

WriteConsole@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes a character string to a console screen buffer at the current cursor position. Returns nonzero on success.

CreateConsoleScreenBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new console screen buffer and returns its handle.

SetConsoleCP@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the input code page used by the console of the calling process.

SetConsoleOutputCP@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the output code page used by the console of the calling process.

AddFontResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds the font resource from the specified file to the system font table. Returns the number of fonts added, or 0 on failure.

AnimatePalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Replaces entries in the specified logical palette; changes are reflected immediately for PC_RESERVED entries. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "AnimatePalette".

Arc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws an elliptical arc, bounded by a rectangle and defined by start and end radial points, using the current pen.

CancelDC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cancels any pending operation on the specified device context.

Chord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a chord (region bounded by an ellipse and a line segment), outlined with the current pen and filled with the current brush.

CloseMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a Windows-format metafile device context and returns a handle to the metafile. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use enhanced metafiles instead.

CopyMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a Windows-format metafile to the specified file, or to memory if the file name is null, and returns a handle to the copy.

CreateBitmap@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a bitmap with the specified width, height, planes and bits per pixel, and returns its handle.

CreateBitmapIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a bitmap with the width, height and color format given in a BITMAP structure, and returns its handle.

CreateBrushIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical brush with the style, color and pattern given in a LOGBRUSH structure, and returns its handle.

CreateDiscardableBitmap@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a discardable bitmap compatible with the given device. Obsolete, 16-bit compatibility only; use CreateCompatibleBitmap instead.

CreateDC_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a device context (DC) for a device (for example a printer or display) by driver and device name. Returns the DC handle, or 0 on failure.

CreateDIBitmap@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a compatible bitmap (DDB) from a device-independent bitmap (DIB) and optionally sets its bits. Returns the bitmap handle.

CreateDIBPatternBrush@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical brush with a pattern from a device-independent bitmap given as a global memory handle. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use CreateDIBPatternBrushPt.

CreateDIBPatternBrushPt@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical brush with a pattern specified by a device-independent bitmap (DIB) in memory. Returns the brush handle.

CreateEllipticRgnIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an elliptical region bounded by the rectangle in a RECT structure, and returns its handle.

CreateFontIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical font with the characteristics given in a LOGFONT structure, and returns its handle.

CreateFont@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical font with the specified height, width, weight, face name and other characteristics, and returns its handle.

CreateHatchBrush@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical brush with the specified hatch pattern and color, and returns its handle.

CreateIC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an information context for a device: a lightweight DC used to query device information without drawing.

CreateMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a device context for a Windows-format metafile. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use CreateEnhMetaFile instead.

CreatePalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical palette from a LOGPALETTE structure, and returns its handle.

CreatePenIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical cosmetic pen with the style, width and color given in a LOGPEN structure, and returns its handle.

CreatePolyPolygonRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a region consisting of a series of polygons, which may overlap, and returns its handle.

CreatePatternBrush@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical brush with the pattern specified by a bitmap, and returns its handle.

CreateScalableFontResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a font resource file (.fot) for a scalable font, for use with AddFontResource.

DeleteMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes a Windows-format metafile or its handle. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; enhanced metafiles use DeleteEnhMetaFile.

DeviceCapabilities@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the capabilities of a printer device driver (paper sizes, bins, resolutions, copies, etc.). Return value depends on the requested capability.

EqualRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Checks whether two regions are identical in size and shape. Returns nonzero if they are equal.

Escape@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets an application access device capabilities not available through GDI. Obsolete; mostly superseded by ExtEscape and standard GDI printing functions.

ExtEscape@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets an application access device-specific capabilities of a driver that are not available through GDI, with input and output buffers.

DrawEscape@WIN32API.INC.desc: Provides drawing capabilities of the video display that are not directly available through GDI.

ExtCreateRegion@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a region from region data (RGNDATA) and an optional transformation, and returns its handle.

FillRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a region using the specified brush.

FrameRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a border around a region using the specified brush, with given border width and height.

FloodFill@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills an area of the display surface bounded by the given color, using the current brush. Provided for compatibility; use ExtFloodFill.

GetROP2@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the foreground mix (binary raster operation) mode of the device context, such as R2_COPYPEN.

GetAspectRatioFilterEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the setting of the current aspect-ratio filter used by the font mapper.

GetBkColor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current background color (COLORREF) of the device context.

GetBkMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current background mix mode of the device context (OPAQUE or TRANSPARENT).

GetBitmapBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the bits of a device-dependent bitmap into a buffer. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use GetDIBits instead.

GetBitmapDimensionEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the dimensions previously set for a bitmap by SetBitmapDimensionEx, in 0.1 mm units.

GetBoundsRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current accumulated bounding rectangle for the device context.

GetCharWidth@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the widths, in logical units, of consecutive characters from the current font. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use GetCharWidth32.

GetCharWidth32@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the widths, in logical units, of consecutive characters in a range from the current font.

GetCharWidthFloat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the fractional widths of consecutive characters in a range from the current font.

GetCharABCWidths@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the ABC widths (A, B and C spacing) of consecutive characters from the current TrueType font, in logical units.

GetCharABCWidthsFloat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the ABC widths of consecutive characters from the current font as floating-point values, in logical units.

GetClipBox@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the smallest rectangle that bounds the visible area of the device context. Returns the region type (e.g. SIMPLEREGION).

GetMetaRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current metaregion of the device context into a region handle.

GetCurrentPositionEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current drawing position of the device context, in logical coordinates, into a POINT.

GetDIBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the bits of a bitmap and copies them into a buffer as a device-independent bitmap using the given format (BITMAPINFO). Returns the number of scan lines copied.

GetFontData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves font metric data for a TrueType font (a table or the whole font file). The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "GetFontData".

GetGlyphOutline@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the outline or bitmap for a character in the TrueType font selected into the device context.

GetGraphicsMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current graphics mode of the device context (GM_COMPATIBLE or GM_ADVANCED).

GetMapMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current mapping mode of the device context (e.g. MM_TEXT).

GetMetaFileBitsEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the contents of a Windows-format metafile into a buffer.

GetMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a handle to a Windows-format metafile stored in a file. Obsolete; use GetEnhMetaFile instead.

GetNearestColor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the color value that most closely matches the specified color in the device's available colors.

GetNearestPaletteIndex@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the index of the logical palette entry that best matches the specified color.

GetObjectType@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the type of the specified GDI object (e.g. OBJ_PEN, OBJ_BRUSH, OBJ_DC), or 0 on failure.

GetOutlineTextMetrics@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves text metrics for TrueType fonts into an OUTLINETEXTMETRIC structure.

GetPaletteEntries@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a range of color entries from a logical palette. Returns the number of entries retrieved.

GetPolyFillMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current polygon fill mode of the device context (ALTERNATE or WINDING).

GetRasterizerCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns flags indicating whether TrueType fonts are installed in the system.

GetRegionData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a RGNDATA buffer with data describing a region. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "GetRegionData".

GetStretchBltMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current stretching mode of the device context, used by StretchBlt.

GetSystemPaletteEntries@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a range of palette entries from the system palette of the device. Returns the number of entries retrieved.

GetSystemPaletteUse@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current state of the system (physical) palette for the device context, e.g. SYSPAL_STATIC.

GetTextCharacterExtra@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current intercharacter spacing of the device context. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "GetTextCharacterExtra".

GetTextAlign@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the text-alignment flags of the device context (e.g. TA_LEFT, TA_TOP, TA_UPDATECP).

GetTextColor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current text color (COLORREF) of the device context.

GetTextExtentPoint@WIN32API.INC.desc: Computes the width and height of a string in the current font. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use GetTextExtentPoint32.

GetTextExtentPoint32@WIN32API.INC.desc: Computes the width and height, in logical units, of a text string in the font selected into the device context.

GetTextExtentExPoint@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves how many characters of a string fit in a given width, and fills an array with partial string extents.

GetViewportExtEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the x- and y-extents of the device context's current viewport into a SIZE.

GetViewportOrgEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the x- and y-coordinates of the viewport origin of the device context into a POINT.

GetWindowExtEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the x- and y-extents of the device context's window (logical extent) into a SIZE.

GetWindowOrgEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the x- and y-coordinates of the window origin of the device context into a POINT.

IntersectClipRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new clipping region from the intersection of the current clipping region and a rectangle. Returns the region type.

InvertRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Inverts the colors in the specified region.

MaskBlt@WIN32API.INC.desc: Combines color data for source and destination bitmaps using a mask bitmap and the given foreground and background raster operations.

PlgBlt@WIN32API.INC.desc: Transfers bits from a source rectangle to a parallelogram in the destination device context, with an optional mask.

OffsetRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves a region by the specified x and y offsets. Returns the region type.

Pie@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a pie-shaped wedge bounded by an ellipse and two radials, outlined with the current pen and filled with the current brush.

PlayMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays the picture stored in a Windows-format metafile on the specified device context.

PaintRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Paints the specified region using the brush currently selected into the device context.

PolyPolygon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a series of closed polygons, outlined with the current pen and filled using the current brush and fill mode.

PtInRegion@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the specified point is inside a region. Returns nonzero if it is.

PtVisible@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the specified point is within the clipping region of the device context.

RectVisible@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether any part of the specified rectangle lies within the clipping region of the device context.

RectInRegion@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether any part of the specified rectangle is within the boundaries of a region.

RestoreDC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Restores a device context to a state previously saved by SaveDC (by index, or -1 for the most recent).

ResetDC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Updates a printer or plotter device context using the settings in a DEVMODE structure.

RealizePalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Maps entries from the logical palette selected into the DC to the system palette. Returns the number of entries mapped.

RemoveFontResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes the fonts in the specified file from the system font table.

ResizePalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Increases or decreases the size of a logical palette to the given number of entries.

SaveDC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Saves the current state of the device context (objects, modes, etc.) on a stack. Returns a value identifying the saved state, for RestoreDC.

ExtSelectClipRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Combines the specified region with the current clipping region using the given mode (RGN_AND, RGN_OR, RGN_COPY, etc.).

SetMetaRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Intersects the current clipping region with the current metaregion and saves the result as the new metaregion.

SelectPalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Selects a logical palette into a device context. Returns the handle of the previous palette.

SetBkColor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the current background color of the device context. Returns the previous background color.

SetBitmapBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the bits of a device-dependent bitmap from a buffer. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use SetDIBits instead.

SetBoundsRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Controls the accumulation of bounding-rectangle information for the device context.

SetDIBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pixels of a compatible bitmap using color data from a device-independent bitmap (DIB). Returns the number of scan lines copied.

SetDIBitsToDevice@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pixels in a rectangle on the device directly from device-independent bitmap (DIB) color data. Returns the number of scan lines set.

SetMapperFlags@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the algorithm the font mapper uses when mapping logical fonts to physical fonts (e.g. ASPECT_FILTERING).

SetGraphicsMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the graphics mode of the device context (GM_COMPATIBLE or GM_ADVANCED; advanced is needed for world transforms).

SetMapMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the mapping mode of the device context, which defines the unit of measure for logical coordinates. Returns the previous mode.

SetMetaFileBitsEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a memory-based Windows-format metafile from the supplied data, and returns its handle.

SetPaletteEntries@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets RGB color values and flags in a range of entries in a logical palette.

SetPixel@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pixel at the specified coordinates to the given color. Returns the color actually set, or -1 on failure.

SetPixelV@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pixel at the specified coordinates to the closest approximation of the given color. Faster than SetPixel; returns nonzero on success.

SetPolyFillMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the polygon fill mode (ALTERNATE or WINDING) used by functions that fill polygons.

StretchDIBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies DIB color data for a rectangle of pixels to a destination rectangle, stretching or compressing it to fit and applying a raster operation.

SetStretchBltMode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the bitmap stretching mode used by StretchBlt (e.g. COLORONCOLOR, HALFTONE). Returns the previous mode.

SetSystemPaletteUse@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets an application specify whether the system palette contains 2 or 20 static colors.

SetTextCharacterExtra@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the intercharacter spacing used when writing text. Returns the previous spacing. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "SetTextCharacterExtra".

SetTextAlign@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the text-alignment flags for the device context (e.g. TA_LEFT, TA_BASELINE, TA_UPDATECP).

SetTextJustification@WIN32API.INC.desc: Specifies extra space to add to break characters in a string so text output is justified.

GetProcAddress@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the address of an exported function or variable from the specified DLL module. Returns 0 if not found.

PlayMetaFileRecord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays a single Windows-format metafile record by executing the GDI function it contains.

CloseEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an enhanced-metafile device context and returns a handle to the enhanced metafile.

CopyEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies an enhanced metafile to a file, or to memory if the file name is null, and returns a handle to the copy.

CreateEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a device context for an enhanced-format metafile, optionally stored on disk. Returns the DC handle.

DeleteEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes an enhanced metafile handle (and the metafile if it is stored in memory).

EnumEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the records of an enhanced metafile, calling an application-defined callback for each record.

GetEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a handle to an enhanced-format metafile stored in the specified file.

GetEnhMetaFileBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the contents of an enhanced metafile into a buffer. Returns the number of bytes copied.

GetEnhMetaFileDescription@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the optional text description of an enhanced metafile into a buffer.

GetEnhMetaFileHeader@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the header record (ENHMETAHEADER) of an enhanced metafile.

GetEnhMetaFilePaletteEntries@WIN32API.IN.desc: Retrieves optional palette entries from an enhanced metafile.

GetWinMetaFileBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts the records of an enhanced metafile to Windows-format metafile records and stores them in a buffer.

PlayEnhMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays the picture stored in an enhanced metafile, scaled to the given rectangle on the device context.

PlayEnhMetaFileRecord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Plays a single enhanced-metafile record by executing the GDI function it contains.

SetEnhMetaFileBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a memory-based enhanced metafile from the supplied data, and returns its handle.

SetWinMetaFileBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts a metafile from the older Windows format to the enhanced format and stores it in memory. Returns the enhanced metafile handle.

GdiComment@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a comment from a buffer into an enhanced-format metafile being recorded.

GetTextMetrics@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a TEXTMETRIC structure with the metrics of the font currently selected into the device context.

AngleArc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a line from the current position to the start of an arc, then the arc defined by center, radius, start angle and sweep angle.

PolyPolyline@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws multiple series of connected line segments using the current pen.

GetWorldTransform@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current world-space to page-space transformation (XFORM) of the device context.

SetWorldTransform@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets a two-dimensional linear transformation (XFORM) between world space and page space. Requires GM_ADVANCED graphics mode.

ModifyWorldTransform@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the world transformation of the device context using the given XFORM and mode (reset, left- or right-multiply).

CombineTransform@WIN32API.INC.desc: Concatenates two world-space to page-space transformations (XFORM) into one.

SetColorAdjustment@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the color adjustment values used by StretchBlt and StretchDIBits in HALFTONE mode.

GetColorAdjustment@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the color adjustment values for the device context into a COLORADJUSTMENT structure.

CreateHalftonePalette@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a halftone palette for the device context, for use with HALFTONE stretch mode.

StartDoc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts a print job described by a DOCINFO structure. Returns the print job identifier, or a value <= 0 on failure.

StartPage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Prepares the printer driver to accept data for a new page.

EndPage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the device that the application has finished writing to a page.

EndDoc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Ends a print job started with StartDoc.

AbortDoc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops the current print job and erases everything drawn since the last StartDoc call.

AbortPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes and discards any paths in the specified device context.

ArcTo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws an elliptical arc and a line from the current position to the arc start; updates the current position to the arc end.

BeginPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a path bracket in the device context; subsequent drawing calls define the path.

CloseFigure@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an open figure in a path by drawing a line from the current position to the figure's first point.

EndPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a path bracket and selects the defined path into the device context.

FillPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes any open figures in the current path and fills the path's interior with the current brush and fill mode.

FlattenPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts any curves in the path selected into the device context into sequences of lines.

GetPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the endpoints and control points of the lines and curves in the path selected into the device context.

PathToRegion@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a region from the path selected into the device context, and returns its handle.

PolyDraw@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a set of line segments and Bezier curves defined by arrays of points and point types.

SelectClipPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Selects the current path as a clipping region, combining it with any existing clipping region using the given mode.

SetArcDirection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the drawing direction (counterclockwise or clockwise) for arc and rectangle functions.

SetMiterLimit@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the limit for the length of miter joins for the device context. Returns the previous limit in a parameter.

StrokeAndFillPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes open figures in the path, strokes its outline with the current pen and fills its interior with the current brush.

StrokePath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Renders the specified path using the current pen.

WidenPath@WIN32API.INC.desc: Redefines the current path as the area that would be painted if it were stroked with the current pen.

ExtCreatePen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a logical cosmetic or geometric pen with the specified style, width, brush attributes, end caps and joins.

GetMiterLimit@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the miter limit for the specified device context.

GetArcDirection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the current arc direction of the device context (AD_COUNTERCLOCKWISE or AD_CLOCKWISE).

GetObject_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a GDI object (pen, brush, font, bitmap, palette) into a buffer. Returns the number of bytes stored.

MoveToEx_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Updates the current drawing position to the given point and optionally returns the previous position.
